HELP PLEASE: The latest thug for your perusal!  This case is so fresh and still smells like free breadsticks. You haven’t seen this incident before on X and I’m working with the owner to find the idiot. 

On March 20th, 2025 between 6:30-7pm, this pajama-wearing gangster who obviously prioritizes comfort over fashion decided he didn’t like a Tesla he saw in the Olive Garden parking lot, causing thousands in damage. This fine eating establishment is located at 2641 N Maize Road in Wichita, KS. 

With your help, we can solve this one. It’s very clear video and the guy has distinctive taste. Wichita is a small town where pretty much everybody knows everybody (the Next Door threads are fire). It’s also home to some cool car YouTubers you likely know. 

Please look closely, share with your friends on and off X and help us find this guy. Let’s not keep him on the bingo card too long 😎🙌
